Spindl (spindl.xyz), a web3/onchain ads and attribution platform founded in 2022 by Antonio García Martínez (early Facebook ads team); CoinDesk calls it Miami-based, while SPC lists it under San Francisco. CoinDesk (Oct 2022) reports it raised $7M co-led by Dragonfly and Chapter One with Polygon Ventures, Tribe Capital, Multicoin and angels. The 'seed' label comes from TokenInsight's headline. Coinbase announced on Jan 31, 2025 that it had acquired Spindl, which now runs under Base (terms not disclosed).
